resources.string: Enables Standard Battery Saver mode which limits visual effects and background activity
Enables Extreme Battery Saver mode which pauses non-essential apps and notifications

Allows users to configure Battery Saver schedules, including automatic activation based on battery percentage and automatic deactivation when charged, as well as managing low-battery notification reminders.
Whether to receive notification reminders when the battery is low
Allows the user to choose a battery saver mode to extend battery life. Extreme battery saver further limits apps and features beyond Standard battery saver mode to save more battery power.
Allows users to enable or disable Adaptive Battery, which optimizes app battery usage based on phone usage patterns to extend battery life.
Whether Adaptive Battery is enabled to optimize battery usage based on app usage patterns.

Provides a centralized dashboard for users to monitor and initiate updates across the operating system, Google Play system components, and installed applications to ensure device security and performance.
